title: 七进制数
summary: 把整数转换为七进制字符串表示。
insight: 对绝对值反复除七并记录余数，得到的低位逆序后再按原符号添加负号。
pitfalls: 零需单独返回字符串零
低位先生成后需要反转

solutions.title: 反复除七取余
solutions.idea: 标准进制转换并处理符号。
steps: value=abs(num)，循环追加 value%7 并 value/=7
若原数为负追加负号，再整体反转

code.java: class Solution { public String convertToBase7(int num){if(num==0)return "0";long value=Math.abs((long)num);StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();while(value>0){answer.append(value%7);value/=7;}if(num<0)answer.append('-');return answer.reverse().toString();} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string convertToBase7(int num){if(num==0)return "0";long long value=llabs((long long)num);string answer;while(value){answer+=char('0'+value%7);value/=7;}if(num<0)answer+='-';reverse(answer.begin(),answer.end());return answer;} };
